sql: WITH x AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 1 AS a) SELECT a + 1, 'x', 1.5, 1e300, -3, 2::DECIMAL(3,1) FROM x, (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) t(b) WHERE a > 3 ORDER BY 1 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5 OFFSET 2
SELECT * EXCLUDE (a, t.b) REPLACE (a + 1 AS c) RENAME (d AS e) FROM t
SELECT COLUMNS(* EXCLUDE x)::VARCHAR, *COLUMNS('a.*') FROM t

SELECT sum(x) FILTER (WHERE x > 0) OVER (PARTITION BY y ORDER BY z ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE TIES), list_transform([1, 2], lambda v: v * 2) FROM t QUALIFY row_number() OVER () = 1
PIVOT t ON a IN (1, 2) USING sum(b) GROUP BY c
UNPIVOT t ON a, b INTO NAME n VALUE v

SELECT x::mytype(1, 'a'), x::INTEGER[3], x::MAP(INT, VARCHAR), x::JSON, 170141183460469231731687303715884105727, 'a'::BLOB, INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM read_csv('f.csv') WITH ORDINALITY USING SAMPLE 10% (bernoulli, 42)
WITH RECURSIVE r(n) USING KEY (n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM r WHERE n < 3) SELECT * FROM r, LATERAL (SELECT r.n) AS l JOIN u USING (n) ASOF JOIN w ON r.n >= w.n

SELECT CASE WHEN a THEN 1 WHEN b THEN 2 END, a BETWEEN 1 AND 2, a IN (1, 2), EXISTS (SELECT 1), a = ANY (SELECT 1), $1, ?, #1, COALESCE(a, b), a COLLATE nocase, DEFAULT FROM t GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((a), (b), ()) HAVING count(*) > 1; SELECT 'second'
FROM t SELECT DISTINCT ON (a) a, b ORDER BY ALL
